scripts.build: npm run build:ops && npm run build:web
scripts.cloudflare:deploy:web: npm run build:web && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/product-web/out --project-name freightpilot --branch main
scripts.cloudflare:deploy:api: uv run --project infra/cloudflare/freightpilot-api python infra/cloudflare/freightpilot-api/scripts/prepare_app.py && uv run --directory infra/cloudflare/freightpilot-api pywrangler deploy
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: npm run build && npm run cloudflare:deploy:web && npm run cloudflare:deploy:ops && npm run cloudflare:deploy:api
